resources.string: Create a course on the Courses tab. Category, topics and schedule are optional. Up to 10 unfinished courses can have colors.
Edit list: one unfinished topic per line. Apply saves it. Hold a saved topic to mark it complete or undo the mark. Manual marks do not create sessions.
Set weekdays and start times in a course. End time and final date are optional; an earlier end means the next day. Allow Android notifications and alarms for reminders.
Sessions shows today and yesterday. Mark Done and select finished topics, or mark Skipped. Done can have no topics; Skipped leaves progress unchanged. Older results are in Calendar.

Pause keeps history but removes the schedule. Finish completes remaining topics. Start again permanently clears topic progress, sessions and schedule. Deleting a course removes its history; calendar cleanup also deletes old sessions.

Make a manual copy before restarting a course, shortening history or changing phones. Weekly backup uses Download/Study Tracker and replaces its previous copy after success; Android may delay it. Keep a separate older copy. Restore fully replaces data; copies cannot be merged. Backup files are not encrypted.
